inputParameters.name: trail_edges
inputParameters.description: The COMPAS CEM trail edges to add to the diagram.

inputParameters.name: deviation_edges
inputParameters.description: The COMPAS CEM deviation edges to add to the diagram.

inputParameters.name: loads
inputParameters.description: The COMPAS CEM loads to add to the diagram.

inputParameters.name: supports
inputParameters.description: The COMPAS CEM supports to add to the diagram.

inputParameters.name: add_auxiliary_trails
inputParameters.description: Whether to append auxiliary trails to the free nodes of the topology diagram. Defaults to False.

inputParameters.name: auxiliary_settings
inputParameters.description: The length, state and direction of the auxiliary trails, from Auxiliary Trail Settings. Applies only when add_auxiliary_trails is on. Defaults to its default settings.
